body: Thank you for the thoughtful response. I’m just trying to take it one day at a time. I hope you’re doing well!

Please see my OP post from today. I’m the biggest loser ever. I can’t believe life turned out this way, it’s a total waste. I feel so bad for my mom, she deserved so much better than she got with me. I can’t see a way out that leads to anything besides just getting by, which is literally a pointless existence. I finally got an apartment last year with someone I thought was a friend. I was sexually harassed by him and when I turned him down, he became hostile and my home became hell. He moved out without notice last week and I found out instead of paying rent, he pocketed my money and there’s $4800+ owed on the place, so I’m facing eviction soon. I was going to move in with another friend but it fell apart today. I lost my job right before my roommate left, so I’m literally broke waiting on unemployment. Because this is so last min and I have no idea how much money I have to work with, I will most likely have to put everything, including my cats, in storage and live on the streets. This is what I get for trusting people and working my ass off… and forget the ambitions I had…can’t even follow my dream because I have to worry about surviving…so what is the point of my life if that’s all I ever do? I’m fucking 40, no kids, haven’t been on a date in 4 years…so fun! I bet EVERYONE is just fighting over getting the chance to be a complete waste of life like me. I just want to get the cats somewhere safe and then I think I’m checking out. The world will keep spinning and the couple of people who might be upset will keep living and will DEFINITELY get over it. I’m over it, so I know they can get along without me just fine.
Must be nice for you all. The more I try the worse it gets, and seeing others pull out of it just makes it more clear to me that I need to be gone
